name: Foundry Design Control
shortDescription: Design precisely in the live product
longDescription: Foundry turns a running product into a local design workbench for coding agents. Select and manipulate rendered elements, inspect project-native tokens and components, review a source-mapped change set, apply only approved changes, and verify the rebuilt result. The workflow keeps project data, preview state, and apply history local.
starterPrompts: Verify the latest Foundry design session.
releaseNotes: Initial public-directory submission of Foundry's local-first visual design workflow for Codex and ChatGPT.
